prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively snowy town square. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands firmly, holding a steaming mug of cocoa while looking at a woman in a blue coat nearby. The woman in the blue coat is pointing toward the center of the scene with her gloved hand. In the center, a large snowman with a carrot nose sits prominently on a wooden bench, serving as a focal point for the gathering. Next to the snowman, a child in a yellow hat reaches out, appearing to adjust the snowman's twig arm. To the right of the snowman, a brown dog sits patiently, its tail curled around its paws, watching the activity with interest. Behind the dog, an elderly person in a green parka leans against a lamppost, observing the square calmly. A black cat perches atop a trash can near the lamppost, staring intently at the brown dog. In the background, a vendor in an orange apron hands a bag of roasted nuts to a teenager in a purple beanie. The teenager in the purple beanie smiles while accepting the treat. A street musician in a gray sweater plays a violin near the edge of the square, adding to the atmosphere. There is no smoke rising from chimneys, keeping the air crisp and clean in this stylized depiction. There is no visible breath from any character, maintaining the clean lines of the artwork. The composition remains balanced with distinct figures spread across the foreground and midground, ensuring each element is clearly distinguishable within the flat design aesthetic.
